Author: Naguya
Name: Aetherhold
Description: Your FFXIV companion. Syncs your character to Aetherhold (aetherhold.naguya.tech) live and brings its tools into the game: market and shopping route, gathering timers, crafting and macro solver, collections, routines, events and raids. Cart, routines and crafter stats stay in step with the website.
Punchline: Aetherhold, in game. Because clicking sync is so 2023.
Changelog: 3.0: renamed to Aetherhold with the website's look; talks to aetherhold.naguya.tech; cart, routines, venture timers and crafter stats shared with the website; caught-fish log fixed; crafting prices load again; token no longer shown in full. Command: /aetherhold (/xivhub still works).
